title: usage
description: A reading of the Claude subscription's usage windows. Written by usage-check, which the loop runs on its schedule. Shows how close the device is to a rate limit. On a subscription login the reading names it (auth subscription) and, when the loop passes one, carries the loop's what-if dollar total for the calendar month (what its work would have cost at API prices, not a bill) with no budget; reasons say why a total is missing.

available.description: true when a reading was had; false when no source gave one (then every reading field is null). A spend reading has available true and null window fields. On a subscription every reading field except auth, the spend fields and their reasons is null when unavailable.

five_hour_pct.description: Percent of the five-hour window used, rounded up.

seven_day_pct.description: Percent of the most used seven-day window, rounded up.

source.description: Where the reading came from; null when unavailable. spend is a spend reading against a budget, which has null window fields.

auth.description: Which login the reading was taken under.

spend_usd.description: Dollars spent in the current budget period up to the reading. On a subscription: the loop's what-if total for the calendar month at API prices; null when it could not be had (see reasons).

budget_usd.description: The budget for that period, in dollars. Null on a subscription, which has no dollar budget.

budget_resets_at.description: When the budget period resets. On a subscription: when the what-if total restarts (00:00 UTC on the 1st).

reasons.description: When unavailable: why, one code per source tried, for example statusline:bad-snapshot; empty otherwise. A subscription reading adds spend codes after them: spend:subscription-no-budget always, and why spend_usd is null (spend:no-tally, spend:no-session-cost, spend:bad-tally, spend:bad-input).
